newsitem.title: POLAND: LOT net profit $15 mln in Jan-Aug - paper.
newsitem.headline: LOT net profit $15 mln in Jan-Aug - paper.

text.p: Poland's PLL LOT airlines had a net profit of about $15 million in the first eight months of 1996, against two million in the whole of 1995, the Rzeczpospolita daily quoted LOT management as saying.
LOT officials were not immediately available for comment.
The company earlier said that it had carried 10,500 tonnes of cargo in the first eight months of 1996, nearly 17 percent more than in the same period last year.
It said it hoped to increase its cargo operation by 20 percent this year, from about 19,000 tonnes in 1995.
